mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept( dept_id, parent_id, dept_name, ancestors, order_num, leader, phone, email, status, create_by, dept_level, tenant_id, tenant_tower_dept_id, tenant_name, remark, app_ver_code, industry_code, MDM_ORG_CODE, create_time )values( #{deptId}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{leader}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{deptLevel}, #{tenantId}, #{tenantTowerDeptId}, #{tenantName}, #{remark}, #{appVerCode}, #{industryCode}, #{mdmOrgCode}, #{createTime} )

mapper.delete: update sys_dept set del_flag = '2' where dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.select: and exists ( with recursive t1(dept_id, parent_id) as ( select t0.dept_id, t0.parent_id from sys_dept t0 where t0.dept_id = #{deptId} union all select t2.dept_id, t2.parent_id from sys_dept t2, t1 where t2.parent_id = t1.dept_id ) select 1 from t1 where t1.dept_id = d.DEPT_ID ) order by d.parent_id ASC, d.dept_id ASC, d.order_num ASC
and d.PARENT_ID = #{parentId}

SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id AS tenantId, d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id, d.parent_name, d.MDM_ORG_CODE as mdmOrgCode, d.industry_code as industryCode FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.INDUSTRY_CODE=#{industryCode}

select d.dept_id as id,a.area_name as areaName,d.tenant_id AS tenantId,a.area_parent_code as pid, d.DEPT_LEVEL as deptLevel,a.area_level as areaLevel from sys_dept d left join sys_area a on d.dept_id = a.area_code where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT d.industry_code as industryCode, u.user_id AS userId FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM cte WHERE n < 50 ) SELECT u_inner.user_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', n), ',', -1) AS split_dept_id FROM sys_user u_inner JOIN cte ON cte.n <= ( LENGTH(u_inner.DEPT_ID) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', '')) + 1 ) WHERE u_inner.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) u_split ON d.dept_id = u_split.split_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u_split.user_id = u.user_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.INDUSTRY_CODE= #{industryCode} and u.user_id is not null

SELECT count(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN ( WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM cte WHERE n < 50 ) SELECT u_inner.user_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', n), ',', -1) AS split_dept_id FROM sys_user u_inner JOIN cte ON cte.n <= ( LENGTH(u_inner.DEPT_ID) - LENGTH(REPLACE(u_inner.DEPT_ID, ',', '')) + 1 ) WHERE u_inner.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) u_split ON d.dept_id = u_split.split_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u_split.user_id = u.user_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.INDUSTRY_CODE= #{industryCode} and u.user_id is not null
